title: Symmetric Bessmertnyĭ Realizations and Field Extension Problems in Characteristic 2 - A Differential Algebra Approach
summary: We present a short, purely algebraic proof of the Symmetric Bessmertnyĭ Realization Theorem in the characteristic $2$ case recently proved in [EOW26]. Symmetric Bessmertnyĭ realizations are Schur complements of affine linear symmetric matrix pencils, and they arise naturally as state-space representations in linear systems theory.
